parrafo.es: Che Pibe Catering prepara empanadas, lasagna, humita y tortilla española de forma casera en Hollywood, FL. Todo fresco, todo hecho el mismo dia, para llevar a tu mesa o a tu evento.
parrafo.en: Che Pibe Catering makes empanadas, lasagna, humita and Spanish tortilla the homemade way in Hollywood, FL. Everything fresh, made the same day, for your table or your event.

hero.imagen_alt: Bandeja de empanadas argentinas recien horneadas de Che Pibe Catering

parrafo_1.es: Che Pibe Catering nacio para llevar los sabores de Argentina a Hollywood: empanadas de carne, jamon y queso, lasagna casera, humita y tortilla de papa española, hechas en el dia con recetas de siempre.
parrafo_1.en: Che Pibe Catering was born to bring the flavors of Argentina to Hollywood: beef, ham and cheese empanadas, homemade lasagna, humita and Spanish potato tortilla, made fresh every day with recipes that never change.

parrafo_2.es: Preparamos pedidos para llevar y para eventos, siempre en un espacio impecable y con atencion directa de la casa.
parrafo_2.en: We prepare orders for pickup and for events, always out of a spotless kitchen with direct, hands-on service.

texto.es: Nos dices que queres: empanadas por docena, una bandeja o un pedido para tu evento.
texto.en: Tell us what you want: empanadas by the dozen, a tray, or an order for your event.

texto.es: Te confirmamos cantidad, precio y el dia en que lo retiras.
texto.en: We confirm the amount, price and the day you can pick it up.

texto.es: Todo se hace fresco el mismo dia, con los mismos ingredientes de siempre.
texto.en: Everything is made fresh the same day, with the same ingredients as always.

texto.es: Pasas por el local en Hollywood y te llevas todo listo, todavia caliente.
texto.en: You stop by the Hollywood location and take it all ready, still warm.

nota.es: Los precios varian segun cantidad y pedido. Llamanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Prices vary by quantity and order. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Carne, jamon y queso, y mas sabores por docena, horneadas el mismo dia.
texto.en: Beef, ham and cheese, and more flavors by the dozen, baked the same day.

texto.es: En bandejas individuales o familiares, con salsa de carne y mucho queso.
texto.en: In individual or family trays, with meat sauce and plenty of cheese.

texto.es: Clasicos de siempre, preparados al momento con receta casera.
texto.en: Classic recipes, prepared fresh the homemade way.

texto.es: Bandejas armadas para cumpleaños, reuniones y celebraciones.
texto.en: Trays put together for birthdays, gatherings and celebrations.

pie.es: Tambien preparamos canastas y pedidos especiales: cuentanos la ocasion.
pie.en: We also prepare gift baskets and special orders: tell us the occasion.

items.quote: Che Pibe's empanadas deserve a special mention, they are, without a doubt, the BEST in the entire Miami-Fort Lauderdale area. The flavors are rich, the pastry is perfectly flaky.
Delicious dishes. Their empanadas are amazing. My favorite is the ham and cheese. The place is impeccable clean, and their customer service is exceptional, very affordable prices.
Great food for great price, AAA recommended.

texto.es: Para pedidos y consultas de catering.
Lunes a viernes 7am a 4pm, sabados 7am a 3pm. Cerrado los domingos.
texto.en: Monday to Friday 7am to 4pm, Saturdays 7am to 3pm. Closed Sundays.
